table.title: Equivalent R and SPSS syntax
rows:
df <- read.csv("review-survey.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c('', 'NA', 'null', 'NULL'))
y <- as.numeric(df$outcome)
X <- as.matrix(df[, c("driver_price", "driver_quality", "driver_service"), drop=FALSE])
ok <- stats::complete.cases(y, X); y <- y[ok]; X <- X[ok, , drop=FALSE]
zs <- function(v) { s <- sqrt(mean((v-mean(v))^2)); if (s < 1e-12) s <- 1e-12; (v-mean(v))/s }
Z <- apply(X, 2, zs); yz <- zs(y)
C <- cor(cbind(Z, yz))
rxx <- C[1:ncol(Z), 1:ncol(Z)]; rxy <- C[1:ncol(Z), ncol(Z)+1]
eig <- eigen(rxx, symmetric=TRUE)
delta <- eig$vectors %*% diag(sqrt(pmax(eig$values, 1e-12)), ncol=ncol(Z)) %*% t(eig$vectors)
beta <- solve(delta, rxy)
raw <- (delta^2) %*% (beta^2)
w <- as.numeric(raw / sum(raw))
cat(sprintf('w1=%.16g\n', w[1]))
cat(sprintf('w2=%.16g\n', if (length(w) > 1) w[2] else 0))
